text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - Latency SLO burn for route `POST /v1/generate` (p95=620ms, p99=2.9s). Pager: PD-98765. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765 — please ack and triage.

morgan: acked. taking oncall. pinging @jamal @sara for quick triage.

morgan: looking at Grafana: https://grafana.example/d/abcd/routes - spike starts 02:14 UTC across us-west2 and us-east1. All traffic classes showing elevated tail.

jamal: I can see batcher queue depth jumped at the same time. batcher-sidecar logs show repeated "batch_wait > 500ms" spikes and increased batch sizes. also some kernel errors on the canary nodes.

sara: adding that oauth-proxy is returning 503s to our router for a subset of requests — egress 5xxs increased ~0.4% at the same timestamp. could be downstream auth throttling causing backpressure.

morgan: hypothesis: new canary (model-gen-v2-rc3) altered sequence distribution, leading to larger batching and backpressure; combined with auth retries that amplify latency. plan: 1) rollback canary, 2) scale batcher pods, 3) drain problematic hosts. Jamal start scale and drain, Sara monitor egress.

jamal: scaling batcher deployment from 6 -> 12 now.

jamal: rolling back canary: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/model-gen-canary --to-revision=1` (starting)

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98765 acknowledged by morgan.

ops-bot: k8s event: scaled deployment `batcher-sidecar` from 6 to 12 (manual) at 02:17:45 UTC.

morgan: rollback applied, draining canary pods from node pool us-west2-canary-1. ETA ~90s to finish drain and stop traffic.

sara: checking telemetry: p95 dropped to 210ms and p99 to 430ms within 2m of rollback/scale. oauth 503s also trending down.

morgan: preliminary customer impact: ~0.6% of requests experienced >2s latency or transient failures during the peak. No sustained error-rate increase after mitigation. filing a short incident ticket and handing off follow-up.

jamal: created ticket INC-2026-789 in tracker (link: https://tickets.example/INC-2026-789) with initial findings and logs attached.

morgan: handing off to @oncall-lead for postmortem if we see reoccurrence. I'll remain watch for 10m then sign off. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
